pitches.logline: A taxi driver on the airport night shift wants to finish his shift with tips and no questions, but a squeal from under the bonnet grows with every fare, and he can't say what it is.
pitches.hook: A passenger slams the back door, the engine squeals on take-off, and the passenger yells at Gela.

pitches.logline: A first-time buyer wants a used BMW from a seller in another town, but all he has is the seller's videos and the seller's promise that the engine runs like a clock.
pitches.hook: The seller's video plays on Luka's phone: under the seller's voice the engine knocks; Luka freezes and turns the volume up.

pitches.logline: A friend's father wants to know what the hum in his car is, and goes from mechanic to mechanic until it has cost him 4 000 GEL; the twist is what the son does in the same courtyard with ten seconds.
pitches.hook: Bondo starts the car in the courtyard, a deep hum rises, he presses his ear to the bonnet.

treatment.logline: Gela, a night taxi driver at the airport bay, wants a quiet shift, but a squeal from his engine gets louder with every fare and he cannot say what it is.
treatment.hero: Gela, a taxi driver in his fifties, knit polo, short grey beard, reading glasses; his graphite crossover at the same airport taxi bay all film
treatment.obstacle: a noise he cannot name, and passengers and other drivers who hear it

hook.event: A passenger at the open rear door yells at Gela as the car jolts on the slam and squeals

act1: Fare 1: the squeal on take-off, the passenger's face rises in the rear-view mirror, Gela turns the radio up
Fare 2: the squeal louder on the road, the couple in the mirror swap an awkward look
Back at the bay: the other drivers turn and stare, Gela lifts the bonnet and has no idea what to look for
treatment.turn: Gela kills the engine: the cab dark, only the indicator ticking on his profile

reveal.what: the phone rises out of the dark; the app has an engine sound check that listens and says what kind of noise it is

screens.step: record the running engine 8 to 10 s

treatment.payoff: Dawn, the same bay and car: the last passenger asks about the noise again and Gela, calm, says he is off to the mechanic
treatment.signature: The rear-view mirror as the film's frame: the passengers' faces rise in its glass with every squeal while the radio's level bars climb

post.description: ღამის ცვლის ბოლოს ყური უკვე ცუდად არჩევს, რა ისმის კაპოტის ქვეშ. შენ ბოლოს რომელმა ხმამ შეგაშინა საჭესთან?
